user.title: Connect to Kitchey
user.description: Enter your Kitchey server URL and a Personal Access Token. Generate tokens in the app under Settings → Advanced → API Keys.

reconfigure.title: Update Kitchey connection
reconfigure.description: Change the server URL and/or Personal Access Token. You pick the household in the next step.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server. Check the URL and your network.
error.invalid_token: Token rejected by server. Generate a new token in the Kitchey app.
